scenario: Create a second synthetic account-scoped person with the same display name and a separate relationship and governed source.
Start another Agent contact draft with the same name and observe both possible people with relationship and source counts.
Enter a new relationship label and a recruiter-owned note that does not contain enough evidence to distinguish the two people.
Save the note for identity review without creating a third person or binding the source to either candidate.
Compare the exact governed source excerpt before the two interpretations.
Record why the identity must remain unresolved and observe that neither person nor relationship changes.
Reload the workspace URL and recover the same case, candidate set, source excerpt, and prior unresolved reason.
Select the original person, deliberately create the new relationship context, record the recruiter's verification basis, and confirm identity.
Observe a completed Agent receipt and a newly published source-linked Wiki snapshot.
Read back the database to verify decision history, selected identity and context, dependency lineage, and non-contamination of the other same-name person.

observed_unresolved_state.reason: The source account or another confirmed handle is still missing.

negative_and_recovery_cases.multiple_name_matches: converted to a durable identity-resolution case
negative_and_recovery_cases.insufficient_identity_evidence: source remains governed but outside both candidate Wikis
negative_and_recovery_cases.page_reload: identity case, exact excerpt, candidates, and prior decision reason are restored
negative_and_recovery_cases.stale_case_version: Web route preserves the backend conflict instead of converting it to a generic failure
negative_and_recovery_cases.cross_origin_mutation: denied before the decision service is called
negative_and_recovery_cases.wrong_candidate_contamination: the other same-name person has zero blocks depending on the ambiguous source

remaining_limits: The candidate comparison currently exposes source-backed counts and relationship labels, but no contrasting confirmed handles because the synthetic collision intentionally lacks them.
Handle correction, expiry, revocation, and source-deletion behavior still need one continuous runtime replay.
The completed Agent operation receipt remains transient after reload even though the unresolved identity case is durable.
The proof is local and synthetic rather than a timed comparison with working recruiters.
